mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a custom patio project with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for custom patio projects begins with a complimentary initial consultation where we discuss your vision, budget, and requirements. Following this, we conduct a site visit to assess your property's specific conditions and take measurements. We then develop a detailed design proposal and material recommendations tailored to your needs. Once approved, we handle all necessary permitting and schedule the construction, keeping you informed throughout each stage until your dream patio is complete. This structured approach ensures clarity and efficiency from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with a consultation, followed by a site visit, detailed design proposal, permitting, and construction. We keep you informed throughout every stage.
